name: Mir Jafar
role: Commander and Later Nawab of Bengal
contribution: A senior commander under Siraj ud-Daulah, Mir Jafar joined the anti-Siraj coalition and was installed as Nawab after the Battle of Plassey.
context: His career reflects the overlap of Bengal court politics, military command, and East India Company intervention in 1756–1757.
impact: His defection and appointment as Nawab were central to Plassey’s political outcome and the Company’s subsequent expansion of influence in Bengal.
highlight: The commander whose alliance with the Company reshaped Bengal’s political order after Plassey.
seoTitle: Mir Jafar and Plassey: Bengal’s Political Power Shift
seoDescription: Explore Mir Jafar’s role in the politics of Siraj ud-Daulah’s court, the Battle of Plassey, and the East India Company’s rise in Bengal.
shortAnswer: Mir Jafar was a Bengal commander who joined the anti-Siraj coalition and became Nawab after the Company victory at Plassey.
